name: ALL-ONE GYM
facts: Private gym in Lakewood, CA at 5436 Woodruff Ave.
Hours: Mon-Fri 5 AM-12 AM, Sat-Sun 5 AM-10 PM; ALL ACCESS 24/5.
Go 10 for 10 each week to win a prize.
suggested: Does it work with my Apple Watch?

qa.a: Monday to Friday 5 AM to midnight, Saturday and Sunday 5 AM to 10 PM. ALL ACCESS members get 24 hours Monday to Friday (24/5, not 24/7).
Tap the QR button at the bottom of the app and show your pass at the front desk.
Your plan has 10 workouts each week (Monday to Sunday). Finish all 10 in the app and you unlock one spin for a prize, like free creatine, 15% off next month, a free PT session or a free month.

qa.q: Does it work with my Apple Watch?
qa.a: The App Store version reads heart rate and workouts from Apple Watch through Apple Health. In this web preview you can connect a Bluetooth heart-rate strap (Android / Chrome) or watch a demo heart rate.
ALL ACCESS, Standard and Restricted, all month to month, plus day passes. Ask the front desk or see all-onegym.com/pricing.
Yes. You can book a free training session with one of our trainers through the front desk.
Yes, plus towel service, a big stretching area, boxing bags and an outdoor gym.

qa.q: Do you sell protein or creatine?
qa.a: Yes, at the front desk: RAW, Isopure, Optimum Nutrition and more, plus energy drinks and ALL-ONE merch.
In this preview, only on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere. The live app stores it securely with your gym account.
Call or text (562) 483-8129, or email allonegymteam@gmail.com.

qa.q: How do I track my weight?
qa.a: Open Progress, type today's weight and tap Log. The chart shows your start, now, total lost and this week.

qa.q: How do I start a workout?
qa.a: Open Train, pick a plan (Burn, Build or Starter) and tap Start. Log each set; the rest timer runs between sets.
ALL ACCESS membership is for ages 21 and up.
